EmailTemplate.subject: ASU School of Music - Recorded Audition Reminder
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for your interest in the ASU School of Music and for submitting your application. We noticed that you indicated that you will upload a recorded audition instead of performing an on-campus audition. The deadline to submit your recorded audition is February 1. Please follow the instructions below for submitting your recorded audition:
1. Review and prepare the audition requirements for your voice/instrument listed here.
2. Record each audition requirement in the acceptable digital format as separate files with clear labels. For example:Mozart_Concerto_Mvt_1 Voice Applicants: all auditions must be in video format: MPEG, MPG, MP4, MOV , AVI, WMV, M4V, VOB Instrumental Applicants: auditions are acceptable in either video or audio format: MPEG, MPG, MP4, MOV, AVI, WMV, M4V, VOB, MP3, M4A, AIFF, WMA, WAV, AAC
3. Email MusicAdmissions@asu.edu your recorded auditions files by February 1. If your files are too large to email, please use either Google Drive or Dropbox and send the link to Musicadmissions@asu.edu
***Auditions submitted as CDs, DVDs, YouTube, or any other method not listed above will not be reviewed***
Attention: Music Therapy and Music Education Applicants: If you selected Music Therapy or Music Education as your first choice degree program, you will need to complete an interview with the faculty via Skype or phone. A member from the faculty in Music Education or Music Therapy will be contacting you via email within the next two months to schedule an interview.
If you have any questions about your recorded audition please contact: MusicAdmissions@asu.edu.
Sincerely,
Julie Stephens Coordinator, Academic Affairs + Admissions Arizona State University | School of Music Po Box 870405 | Tempe, AZ 85287-0405 Phone: 480-965-5069
